description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for managing user profile operations in a sports live stream platform. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, searching, and deleting user profiles, utilizing async database interactions with SQLAlchemy ORM models. The code emphasizes header/query-based user identification, with utility functions to resolve trusted user IDs.
